feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 10 September 2026 6:24am
items.description:
##Today##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain or drizzle spreading in during the morning and early afternoon. This will become patchier as the afternoon goes on, before eventually clearing to leave clear spells later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

2-5


##Wind Speed##

23


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 20-25, perhaps occasionally 30 late morning and afternoon. Then veering W or SW 15-20 by the evening.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle. Hill fog becoming isolated later.


##Comments##

Strong winds for a time. Frontal fragmentation causing some uncertainty with rainfall timings.


##Tomorrow##

Dry, starting with sunny spells before turning cloudier later in the day with a rain arriving late in the night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4 later


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W 15-20, backing SW 10-15. Then backing S 15-20 later, then increasing 20-25 overnight, then 25-30 near end of period.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog increasing later.


##Comments##

Strong winds later.


##Saturday, 12 September 2026##

Cloudy with a band of rain or drizzle moving through during the morning, potentially heavy in places. This will clear by the afternoon to leave drier spells, though still with occasional outbreaks of light rain or drizzle for the rest of the day.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 18°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

3-6


##Wind Speed##

26


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 25-30, with gusts 35-45, decreasing 20-25 late morning, then 15-20 through the afternoon. Then veering NW 10-15 in the evening.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds until later.


##Sunday, 13 September 2026##

Dry with bright or sunny intervals, risk of outbreaks of rain later in the night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C

0-2 later


##Wind Speed##

10

W


##Wind##

NW 5-15, backing SW or S in the afternoon, then SE for a time later.

Mainly good. Isolated hill fog patches.


##Comments##

Nil.

Rather cloudy, with outbreaks of rain or drizzle at times.
